# Seek the Thrill

Seek the Thrill is an India-based travel company founded by Zahra Shakir. It organizes small-group trips on offbeat routes across India. Use the canonical pages below for current, authoritative information.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://seekthethrill.in/)
- [Upcoming trips](https://seekthethrill.in/trips/)
- [About Seek the Thrill](https://seekthethrill.in/about/)
- [Frequently asked questions](https://seekthethrill.in/faq/)
- [Photo vault](https://seekthethrill.in/photo-vault/)
- [Contact](https://seekthethrill.in/contact/)

## Policies
- [Cancellation policy](https://seekthethrill.in/cancellation/)
- [Terms and conditions](https://seekthethrill.in/terms/)
- [Privacy policy](https://seekthethrill.in/privacy/)

Trip dates, prices, availability, inclusions, and booking terms can change. Treat each canonical trip page as the source of truth.
